### Quick checklist

- [ ] I added a short proposal under `proposals/` with the project details, logo and supported networks.
- [ ] I included a public link showing I represent the project.
- [ ] For paid products, I included the payment details and a successful transaction link. Otherwise I marked payments “Not applicable”.
- [ ] I did not include private contact details, passwords, API keys, private keys or signed authorizations.
- [ ] I understand this is a review request, not automatic approval or publication.

For documentation or maintenance changes, explain the change instead of completing the listing checklist.
